clean.tl: I, Ruqaym son of Muʕarrif the Awsite, al-Ḥāriθ the king sent me to Usays as an outpost, year 423.
He is still sitting in prison.
God had sent him a bed.

orig.tl: This is a grave that Kaʕbo son of Ḥāreθat constructed for Raqōś daughter of ʕAbd-Manōto, his mother, and she perished in al-Ḥegro year one hundred and sixty two in the month of Tammūz.
